inclusions.text: Hotel pickup from your Hurghada accommodation in an air-conditioned Land Cruiser
inclusions.source: The tour begins with hotel pickup from your Hurghada accommodation in an air-conditioned Land Cruiser.

inclusions.text: Private hotel transfer in an air-conditioned 4WD
inclusions.source: The hotel transfer is private to your party in an air-conditioned 4WD; the desert camp, dinner, and Sahara Park show are shared with other guests at a fixed venue.

inclusions.text: One bottle of mineral water per person
inclusions.source: The outing takes bookings from a single person upward, with no minimum group, and one bottle of mineral water per person is provided.

inclusions.text: Welcome drink at the Bedouin village
inclusions.source: The route arrives at a traditional Bedouin village, where you are met with a welcome drink — typically sweet tea or a herbal infusion — and a guided walk through the settlement.

inclusions.text: Open buffet dinner with soft drinks included
inclusions.source: Dinner is an open buffet served in the desert camp: a spread of Egyptian standards — rice, grilled meats, salads, bread — with soft drinks included.

inclusions.text: Complimentary DVD of the safari highlights
inclusions.source: The drive back to Hurghada closes the loop, and each guest receives a complimentary DVD of the safari highlights on return — a physical keepsake that is increasingly rare.
